state_budget_rule.interpretation: The causal counter and 1024-entry bound remain fixed. Only certified evidence refinement grows with Qwen hidden width, capped at the official ten-reference target. Total external-state bytes divided by model parameters must strictly decrease.

causal_memory_invariant: Only numbered list items between the official CWE context marker and held-out final question are counted. Multiword items remain atomic. The outputs field is used solely for a post-read set audit and scoring. Exceeding 1024 unique items is a hard failure.
certified_fusion_invariant: ASCENT appends only target-blind top-frequency items decoded from the bounded causal counter to the exact frozen Foundation output. The Foundation text is retained byte-for-byte, so certified evidence cannot remove an already correct reference.
measurement_boundary: Foundation is one exact greedy full-context decode. Fixed and scale ASCENT scores append certified counter evidence without a second neural decode. Counter time/state and model decode time/memory are reported separately.
original_absolute_gain_confirmation_gate: Every endpoint gain must have a positive seed-clustered t(2) lower bound; both paired adjacent gain differences and the log-parameter slope must have positive t(2) lower bounds; every seed must have positive endpoint gains and positive adjacent differences; no scale ASCENT regression is allowed; scale expansion must beat fixed three-word evidence at 1.5B and 3B; exact parser, provenance, clean-tree, native-length, and strictly decreasing relative-state-cost gates must pass.

ceiling_aware_secondary_estimand.name: fraction_of_foundation_remaining_error_eliminated
ceiling_aware_secondary_estimand.gate: Both paired adjacent differences must have positive three-seed t(2) lower bounds. If Foundation is already perfect, the cell is undefined and must be reported rather than imputed.
ceiling_aware_secondary_estimand.rationale: Absolute accuracy gain is right-censored when scale ASCENT reaches 1.0; a perfect arm cannot demonstrate an impossible score above 1.0.

interpretation: Confirmatory cross-architecture test on three entirely new official Qwen2.5 CWE data seeds at 16K. FPVM is excluded by user direction. The original absolute-gain gate and pre-score ceiling-aware secondary are both reported.
